_comment: 1.8.5 Crafting at Bram's forge (the rebuilt Workshop in the village square). A recipe costs coins and/or items. kind 'building' puts the crafted helper into storage (place it from Shop > Decor > Helpers); kind 'item' adds it to the barn. The Crafting skill (skills.json) can make an extra one or use fewer materials. Numbers for the helpers' effects are in `helpers`.

recipes.name: Sprinkler
recipes.about: Waters the fields around it: crops you sow near it grow 12% faster.

recipes.name: Auto-Feeder
recipes.about: Feeds the hungry animals in the homes around it, using feed from your barn.

recipes.name: Quality Fertiliser
recipes.about: A rich blend. Sow a field with it for a big chance of silver and gold.
